title: Under Pressure
instruction: Reconnect the canopy for the lion-tailed macaques, restore the frog breeding site, and lift forest cover to 22.
intro: A dry spell has arrived and Lantana is on the move. You cannot fix everything — decide which connections matter most.

events.title: Dry spell
events.text: A hot, dry week: the team has 1 less capacity this round and nothing regrows on its own.

events.title: Lantana in the east
events.text: Lantana threatens the east patch edge.

events.title: Lantana in the west
events.text: Lantana has crossed into the West Woodland beside the fig.

objectives.label: Canopy route for the lion-tailed macaques
Frog breeding site at the stream

uses_insight.text: Field reports from the River Edge marked this streamside site for the gliding frogs.

challenge.text: Keep the West Woodland fig healthy through the Lantana spread.
